drawdown.type: end-of-day trailing: floor = highest end-of-day balance minus 2000, updated only at the end of each trading day, never moves down; enforced in real time against net liquidation (balance plus open P&L); touching or falling below it fails the account permanently
drawdown.lockNote: the floor locks at 50100 when an end-of-day balance reaches 52100, or immediately when a payout is requested, whichever comes first

dailyLossLimitNote: soft breach: trading pauses until the next session at 18:00 ET; the account stays open; losses can run past the limit before it triggers

fundedRules.microscalping: more than 50% of trades and of profit must come from trades held longer than 10 seconds, or payouts are blocked
fundedRules.algo: allowed only for a strategy you own exclusively, not high-frequency, used only at Tradeify, with proof of ownership on request
fundedRules.hedging: not allowed, including opposing positions on correlated products or across accounts

select-flex.name: Select Flex 50K Funded (5-day payouts)
select-flex.scalingNote: set from the end-of-day balance, effective the next trading day; once a tier is reached it is kept even if the balance falls

select-daily.name: Select Daily 50K Funded (daily payouts)
select-daily.scalingNote: set from the end-of-day balance, effective the next trading day; once a tier is reached it is kept even if the balance falls

payout.profitGoalNote: profit earned since the last payout; goal 1 for payout 1, goal 2 for every later payout

unverified: Growth consistency: modelled per payout cycle (largest profitable day since the last payout at or below 35% of profit since the last payout); the Growth page does not say whether the window resets.
DLL raise to $2,000 at a $53,000 balance: modelled as permanent once reached; the page does not say whether it reverts.
Daily loss: modelled on realized plus open P&L for the session.
Select scaling triggers use end-of-day profit (balance minus 50,000).
